tasks.label: Wait for FastAPI
args: $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(60); do { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/utils/health-check/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if ($response.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host 'FastAPI is ready'; exit 0 } } catch {} Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline); Write-Error 'Timed out after 60 seconds waiting for FastAPI at http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/utils/health-check/'; exit 1

tasks.label: Wait for Vite
args: $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(60); do { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5173' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if ($response.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host 'Vite is ready'; exit 0 } } catch {} Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline); Write-Error 'Timed out after 60 seconds waiting for Vite at http://localhost:5173'; exit 1
